title: 1994 AMC 8 Problem 21
statement: A gumball machine contains \(9\) red, \(7\) white, and \(8\) blue gumballs. The least number of gumballs a person must buy to be sure of getting four gumballs of the same color is

solutions.text:
In the worst case, a person could draw \(3\) red, \(3\) white, and \(3\) blue, which is \(9\) gumballs, without yet having four of any color.

The next (tenth) gumball must match one of these colors, giving four of that color. So \(10\) gumballs are needed.

Thus, the correct answer is C .
hints: Consider the worst case: how many gumballs can you draw with at most three of each color?
Each color has at least three available, so you could draw three of each before the next one forces a fourth
